about_the_game:
SURVIVORS-LIKE IN 3D. WITH PHYSICS. INSANE AMOUNTS OF PHYSICS.

This demo exists for one reason: to show you what peak physics chaos looks like.

No pressure. No deaths. No stress.

Just hundreds of skeletons, explosive weapons, and ragdoll physics that'll make you smile.

Try it. Watch the bodies fly. Then imagine what the full game is like.

🎮 WHAT'S IN THE DEMO

🛡️ IMMORTAL MODE No stress - just pure chaos enjoyment. You're invincible. Your only mission is to test the carnage and watch bodies fly.

⚔️ WEAPONS PLAYGROUND Try a selection of weapons from the full game.

🧟 ONE ENEMY TYPE, INFINITE CHAOS Face endless waves of skeletal warriors. Simple enemies, complex physics. Watch them crash into each other, knock each other down, and create beautiful chain reactions.

🎯 ONE LEVEL OF PURE MAYHEM A focused arena designed to showcase the physics madness. No progression stress. No learning curve. Just you, weapons, and hundreds of ragdolling skeletons.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K / AMD Ryzen 3 1200 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-6800K / AMD Ryzen 5 1600 or equivalent (6-core, 12-thread)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1070 / Or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: Survivors-like in full 3D with ragdoll physics. Enemies throw themselves at you as projectiles, crash into allies, and damage each other. Bodies fly. Chaos reigns. Survive waves of undead in the most satisfying horde-slaughter you've ever seen. 🔥💀
